Ordering authority for the active deque; CMapSceneryComponent_Render walks that deque in order. FULLY DECODED from disassembly.

Locals: [ebp-0x24] count, [ebp-0x18] i (candidate index), [ebp-0x1C] j (scan index),
[ebp-0x30] best, [ebp-0x34] insertIndex, [ebp-0x28] inA, [ebp-0x2C] inB, ebx enA, [ebp-0x3C] enB.
Span pairs: entry ([ebp-0x80], [ebp-0x7C]), incoming ([ebp-0x88], [ebp-0x84]).
CORRECTION to an earlier revision of this comment, which had those two swapped.

WARNING: [ebp-0x34] has two lifetimes. In the backward branches it is insertIndex; in the
forward branches it is the second element of the neighbour's coordinate pair at [ebp-0x38].
That reuse is why HLIL renders this function as if an insert could re-enter the candidate loop.

0x635AFB null subcomponent returns. 0x635B07 uses this+0x74, not the loaded deque at this+0x34.
0x635B0D count via 0x73C846. 0x635B18 branches on the incoming's vtable +0x0C subtype.

Non-type-2 path (0x635B26..0x635BC6) - PARENTING, not insertion. Scans for a type-2 entry whose
footprint contains the incoming's tile (CMapSceneryType2Subcomponent_FootprintContainsTile) and on
a hit tail-calls CMapSceneryType2Subcomponent_InsertChildForDepth, leaving the deque untouched.
Exhaustion does NOT append: 0x635BC9 sets the sentinel to -1 and falls into the shared path, so an
unclaimed non-type-2 subcomponent is depth-inserted exactly like a type-2 one.

Shared depth path. Per candidate i, with (inA,inB) and (enA,enB) from vtable +0x14 and both spans
from CGameMap_GetType3SubcomponentDepthSpanOrDefault:
  0x635C5E/0x635C6E  axis-A overlap, else skip candidate (jg 0x635CED)
  0x635CED/0x635CFD  axis-B overlap, else skip candidate (jg 0x635D78)
  0x635C7B  on A overlap: inB < enB -> BACKWARD 0x635D8F, else FORWARD 0x635C87
  0x635D08  on B overlap: inA < enA -> BACKWARD 0x635E7C, else FORWARD 0x635D14

FORWARD scan (0x635C87, 0x635D14): best = i, j = i+1; walk while j < count. Null entry skips.
Per neighbour sum_j = jA + jB: if sum_j == enA + enB, best = j and continue; else if
inA + inB <= sum_j, stop; else best = j and continue. Then 0x635D78 advances i.

BACKWARD scan (0x635D8F, 0x635E7C): insertIndex = i, j = i-1; walk while j >= 0. Null entry skips.
Per neighbour sum_j: if sum_j != enA + enB and inA + inB >= sum_j, stop; if j <= best, stop;
else insertIndex = j. Then insert BEFORE insertIndex via CopyBeginIterator + IteratorPlusOffset +
StdDequePtr_Insert (0x635E18 / 0x635F08).

SCAN TERMINATION - RESOLVED, and it is not re-entrant. 0x635E1D tests i < count and returns to
0x635FAA. Every backward insert reaches it with i still a valid candidate index, so i < count
always holds and the function returns. 0x635E29 is therefore reachable ONLY from 0x635BF1
(count <= 0) or from 0x635F0D with the sentinel at -1.

Outer exit 0x635D87: esi = best, then 0x635F0D. Sentinel -1 means nothing matched.

TAIL 0x635F16: recomputes count, and best < count-1 inserts at begin + best + 1 while the last
slot falls to PushBack - the same position. Both arms mean INSERT AFTER best.

FALLBACK 0x635E29 (empty deque, or no candidate matched): pure sum ordering. Walk ebx from 0;
insert before the first entry with inA + inB < enA + enB (0x635E69 -> 0x635F66), else PushBack.

AXIS MAPPING - RESOLVED: +0x0C is tile X and +0x10 is tile Y. The coordinate writers and
CMapScenerySubcomponent_GetTileCoordinates (0x6D1E51) establish that mapping; the managed
implementation therefore uses X/Y names rather than provisional axis-A/axis-B names.

Managed status: the full comparator, overlap handling, forward/backward neighbour scans, fallback
sum ordering, and active-deque insertion are implemented in Conquer.Map.MapSceneryDepthOrdering
and wired through Role3DClientSceneMapSceneryComponent. Roles register as CMapObj members of that
same active deque. Actual role-body draw consumption from the deque remains a separate managed
rendering concern; this comment records only the native ordering contract and its managed insertion
status.
